name: New York Responsible AI Safety and Education (RAISE) Act
summary: New York frontier-model safety law. Signed 19 December 2025 (Chapter 699) and reshaped by chapter amendment S8828, signed 27 March 2026 as Chapter 96 of 2026 and effective 1 January 2027; the signing and effective date come from the Senate bill page. Per a law-firm alert (Wiley), the amendment adds a 10^26 operations and $500 million revenue threshold, a new office in the Department of Financial Services, and a 72-hour incident reporting window; those details were not checked against the S8828 text.
key_obligations: Large frontier developers to maintain and publish safety frameworks (secondary source)
Report safety incidents within 72 hours (secondary source)
Civil penalties up to $1 million first violation and $3 million subsequent (secondary source)

timeline.note: S6953B signed by the Governor, Chapter 699.
Chapter amendment S8828 signed, Chapter 96 of 2026; effective 1 January 2027.
